status_note: Written before any buffered-ensemble result was computed for the main research run. The 2-year holdout has already been viewed by earlier runs, so it is NOT pristine; forward paper trading is the only clean test.
hypothesis: Most of the 20-session ensemble's modelled cost (0.37-0.50% per period at ~40% turnover) comes from replacing names that are still near the top of the ranking. Keeping a held name while it stays inside the top 40%, and buying new names only from the top 20%, should lower turnover and cost without materially changing gross excess.

variant.name: model:ensemble_buffered
variant.score: the leakage-free walk-forward rank ensemble used by the gate (research.py)
variant.accounting: holdings_simulation.simulate with the same per-name cost model, benchmark and rebalance calendar as the unbuffered ensemble

evaluation.discovery: walk-forward periods only; reported as gross / cost / net / turnover
evaluation.holdout: summarised once per run, sign check only
evaluation.multiple_testing: the walk-forward net series joins strategy_returns, so DSR, PBO, White RC and Hansen SPA count it as an extra trial

gate: none. The research gate keeps evaluating the unbuffered ensemble. Promotion needs a new frozen recipe and its own forward record.
frozen_parameters: no parameter in this file may change after results are seen without registering cross-section-turnover-v2
